policy.admissionRule: strictAccepted is true only when migration status is complete and every listed gate passes

gateDefinitions.label: Authoritative baseline
gateDefinitions.requirement: The manifest adopts source-hash-bound Adobe/original-runtime evidence at native size; when a paired FLA exists, a current recursive, hash-bound per-file Animate authoring audit is required so timeline coverage can be treated as exhaustive; every structurally reachable timeline has a complete hash-bound disposition; nested or interactive coverage-v2 requirements use exact natural-entry traces, while non-interactive root evidence may use a declared frame-accurate natural, direct-seek, or root-entry sequential-step baseline. Candidates, blocked/limited traces, shallow legacy authoring audits, and cross-domain baselines never qualify.

gateDefinitions.label: Implementation and route
gateDefinitions.requirement: The renderer, product route, component, pure timeline, tests, and generated-registry module are declared and exist; explicit frame domains also require a current hash-bound pure getFrameState renderer-support audit.

gateDefinitions.label: Deterministic frame contract
gateDefinitions.requirement: frame/frameDomain/requirementId/trace/entryStateSha256/scenario/lang/seed parameters and data-flash-frame/data-flash-frame-domain/requirement/trace/state attributes are declared and proven by explicit canonical traces; direct pure getFrameState probes must return exact domain/frame/scenario/language identity and a non-blocked renderable state.

gateDefinitions.label: Full-frame and all-scenario coverage
gateDefinitions.requirement: Every structurally reachable timeline is dispositioned, every one-indexed frame exists for every explicit coverage-v2 frame-domain trace requirement (or the legacy v1 root scenario/language matrix), and every explicit requirement has renderable-exact pure-state probes at its first and last frame, with hashed capture and metrics manifests.

gateDefinitions.label: RMSE thresholds
gateDefinitions.requirement: Every canonical frame in every paired requirement/domain/trace/state record is within its static or transition threshold, or has a matching written owner-accepted exception.

gateDefinitions.label: English and Spanish evidence
gateDefinitions.requirement: Both en and es are declared and have valid canonical frame evidence for every required frame-domain trace.

gateDefinitions.label: Audio hash, listening, and sync
gateDefinitions.requirement: Audio files are hashed and inventoried, and authoritative listening, host-state traversal, language, and synchronization are accepted; no-audio claims are proved.

gateDefinitions.label: Replay, interaction, and random branches
gateDefinitions.requirement: A canonical behavior QA record proves Replay by mouse/Enter/Space/reset and every applicable interaction, scoring, completion, seeded/random outcome, and explicit coverage-v2 trace.

gateDefinitions.label: Desktop/mobile/a11y/console/network QA
gateDefinitions.requirement: Canonical product QA covers every explicit trace plus desktop, tablet, mobile, keyboard, names, reduced motion, overflow, localization, console, assets, and unexpected network activity.

gateDefinitions.label: Engineering review
gateDefinitions.requirement: migration.json contains an accepted, dated engineering review; an engineering prereview does not count.

gateDefinitions.label: Human visual review
gateDefinitions.requirement: A named human accepts every current requirement, frame diff, and contact-sheet page in an immutable hash-bound record; migration.json is only a matching acceptance mirror.

gateDefinitions.label: Owner acceptance
gateDefinitions.requirement: The owner explicitly accepts the exact hash-bound human, audio, behavior, product, and exception evidence in an immutable record; Codex never infers or signs this gate.

gateDefinitions.label: Strict validator
gateDefinitions.requirement: The current checked-in strict validator passes the migration without --allow-draft.

gateDefinitions.label: Regression tests
gateDefinitions.requirement: A current, migration-manifest-bound verification record proves the required test suites passed.

gateDefinitions.label: Production build
gateDefinitions.requirement: A current, migration-manifest-bound verification record proves the production build passed.

traceEvidence.note: A ready trace spec is an execution instruction; it is never baseline authority without a verified original-runtime execution report.
